title: Delete files with confirmation
summary: Removes files one by one, asking for confirmation before deleting each one. This helps prevent accidental deletion of wrong files.

steps.explain: Prompts you to confirm the removal of each file. Type 'y' to delete or 'n' to skip.

placeholders.name: FILE_PATHS
placeholders.description: One or more paths to the files you want to delete.

warnings: Deleted files are not moved to the Trash/Recycle Bin and cannot be easily recovered.
Always read the prompt carefully to ensure you are deleting the intended file.

rollback.explain: There is no built-in command to undo file deletion. You must restore from a backup if available.
